title: Complete binary tree: the last level fills from left to right without gaps
summary: The first three levels are full. The fourth level occupies its five leftmost positions, leaving only the three rightmost positions empty.
description: The tree on the left has four levels and no node values. The first three levels contain 1, 2, and 4 nodes. From left to right on level three, each of the first two nodes has both children, the third has only a left child, and the fourth has no children. Thus the five leaves on level four occupy its five leftmost positions.

The right-hand title reads “Complete binary tree.” A long arrow points left beneath the tree. The gray note says, “The lowest level is filled from the left; all other levels are full.” There can be no gaps between nodes on the last level.

frames.title: Complete binary tree: the last level fills from left to right without gaps
frames.explanation: Counting gives height 3 and 12 nodes, satisfying the definition of a complete binary tree. Three positions on the right of level four are empty, so the tree is not perfect.
